info.name: TA9 Document Processing
info.description:
Proof-of-concept flow. Start the stack with `docker compose up --build`, then run the requests in order (or use Collection Runner). 'Create job' stores {{jobId}} for the following requests. Processing is asynchronous: re-run 'Get job' until the status is Completed.

Authentication: set the collection variable apiKey to the operator key (TA9_OPERATOR_KEY in .env, created by ./scripts/keys.ps1; print it with ./scripts/keys.ps1 -Show). The internal Processor requests use serviceKey (TA9_JOB_SERVICE_KEY). Health checks are anonymous.

variable.description: Operator key (full access): TA9_OPERATOR_KEY from .env, printed by ./scripts/keys.ps1 -Show
Job Service key, only for the internal Processor requests in folder 4: TA9_JOB_SERVICE_KEY from .env

request.description: Server-Sent Events. Postman shows the stream; or use: curl -N http://localhost:5001/api/jobs/<id>/events
Published asynchronously a few seconds after the job finishes.

exec: pm.test('202, or 409 if it already finished', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([202, 409]));
